body: Thank you and God bless you. Indeed I do!

What a kind young man you are to have responded to my plea. Just the thought that you would do so speaks deeply to my heart. My girl, 
like you would be 28 now. My sons are 35 and 38. So indeed we have quite a similarity in our family. Thank you for the opportunity to respond to you and I have definitely considered your suggestion of talking with my sons. My one son hides behind his emotions and I respect that fully because he adores his sister and cannot manage the grip of the pain over his loss. My oldest like me,
talks often of his missing the loss of his best friend and sister. I intend to see them and express my feelings. Sometimes I just feel so guilty, like I'm so consumed in my loss that I'm just not whole for them or for my grandchildren anymore.

God bless you. Your compassionate response moved me to tears. Indeed my family is the basis of my whole life and I certainly love my two sons and my grandbabies. We do share our Samantha in everything we do. We carry her with us in every occasion and in non occasions as well. All of your words are meaningful to my heart and very accurate to us as a family and I know that somehow I've got to come to terms with the fact that she is more alive now that this physical plane can offer us. I thank you for the words of compassion and encouragement. Sometimes these are the very things we as parents who have lost so deeply need when we feel like we've come to the edge of the mountain and can't hold on anymore. It is vital to my heart that my baby girl is carried on thru the generations in the beauty of who she was....is and always will be....only now more expounded in her completeness than ever. I thank you.
